description:
Update the eQUEST project parameters to reflect a relocation of the 4StoreyBuilding to Memphis, TN (ASHRAE Climate Zone 3A). You must modify the project-level Site and Build parameters (not the HVAC or Building Shell trees directly). 

1. Locate the 'Site Parameters' block and update:
   - Altitude: 285 ft
   - State: 24 (Tennessee)

2. Locate the 'Build Parameters' block and update the 12 monthly undisturbed ground temperatures (GROUND-T) to the following values (Jan-Dec):
   48, 50, 55, 62, 70, 77, 81, 81, 75, 65, 55, 49

3. After making these changes, run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation and save the project.
